articles.summary: BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, will issue third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A conference call to discuss the Company’s results will be hosted by Shyam Reddy, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Kelly Wall, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET. A webcast of the conference call and accompanying presentation materials will be available in the Investor Relations section of the BlueLinx website at https://investors.bluelinxco.com , and a replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the webcast is complete. To participate in the live teleconference: North America (Toll-Free): 1-833-461-5787 International (Toll): 1-585-542-9983 Passcode: 692 121 823 ABOUT BLUELINX BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC) is a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of residential and commercial building products
articles.title: BlueLinx to Host Third Quarter 2026 Results Conference Call and Webcast on November 4, 2026

articles.summary: BlueLinx continues to advance its Outdoor Living specialty products strategy by expanding access to high-demand decking solutions in targeted U.S. markets BlueLinx is expanding Fiberon® decking to 34 locations and railing to 15 locations Upon completion of the rollout, BlueLinx will offer decking and railing solutions in 47 locations, significantly expanding its Outdoor Living locations into a national presence BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced that it is expanding Fiberon ® decking to 31 additional BlueLinx distribution centers in key U.S. markets, bringing the company’s total Fiberon decking footprint to 34 locations. BlueLinx will also stock Fiberon railing in 15 locations, expanding its commitment to Fiberon’s high-performance Outdoor Living product portfolio. The expansion advances BlueLinx’s Outdoor Living specialty products growth strategy by expanding customer access to category-leading Fiberon
articles.title: BlueLinx Accelerates Outdoor Living Expansion with Fiberon® Decking in 34 Locations and Railing in 15 Locations
